svg.title: A fast night dip and recovery
svg.desc: Real 1-minute CGM readings during a fast overnight drop and recovery. Savitzky-Golay's newest value dips below the lowest raw reading, Kalman Balanced follows the readings closely, Exponential lags behind the recovery.
svg.text: A fast night dip and recovery
Real 1-minute readings. Savitzky-Golay's newest value overshoots below the lowest reading; Kalman stays close to it.
Newest value each loop cycle would have used
oref delta (mg/dL per 5 min) each cycle
